title: Wide Learning: Learning to Reach Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.29608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning is usually evaluated after an evidence interface has been fixed. A dataset, sensor suite, query language, action set, or experimental protocol determines which observations can be obtained, and learning is judged by what it extracts from them. We study a complementary capability. A learner's state can determine which evidence-generating experiments it can reliably realise under bounded resources, even when primitive affordances remain fixed. We call this learner-relative experiment family its effective epistemic reach, and use Wide Learning for task-relevant learning-induced changes in that family.We formalise effective reach relative to learner state, deployment budget, reliability threshold, and evaluation distribution. In a controlled construction, two hidden worlds have exactly the same public observation law. An informative diagnostic exists in a fixed five-primitive substrate. translated_title: 广度学习：学会触及证据
translated_abstract: 机器学习通常是在证据接口被固定之后才被评估的。数据集、传感器套件、查询语言、动作集合或实验协议决定了能够获取哪些观测，而学习则依据它能从中提取出什么来评判。我们研究一种互补的能力：即使原始可供性保持不变，学习者的状态也能决定它在有限资源下能够可靠地实现哪些产生证据的实验。我们将这一相对于学习者的实验族称为其“有效认知触及范围”，并用“广度学习”指代该族中与任务相关的、由学习引起的变化。我们相对于学习者状态、部署预算、可靠性阈值和评估分布对有效触及范围进行了形式化。在一个受控构造中，两个隐藏世界具有完全相同的公共观测规律。一个信息丰富的诊断存在于固定的五原语基底中。在校准之前，一个地址……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“广度学习”这一新概念，将学习者的状态视为决定其在有限资源下能可靠实现哪些产生证据实验的能力，并形式化了“有效认知触及范围”作为机器学习评估的互补维度。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "Wide Learning," formalizing a learner's "effective epistemic reach"—how its learned state determines which evidence-generating experiments it can reliably realize under bounded resources—as a complementary evaluation dimension beyond fixed evidence interfaces.
